notes.title: v0.1.1 Version update
notes.content:
1. Fixed network synchronization bug
2. Added management and synchronization of economic resources in multiplayer mode
3. Added some economic acquisition methods
4. Added settlement UI at the end of the game
5. Added custom level and map loading
6. Added creative workshop module upload

notes.title: Playtest has been open for a long time
notes.content:
Open for A Long Time
Playtest will be open for a long time, and will be mainly used for gameplay demonstration, function testing, feedback collection, etc. Players can submit a game test application to play the beta version of the game. Playtest is currently open for registration, and applicants will be automatically added to the playtest.
Early Version
The game is currently in a very early version, with many serious bugs, and the functions are not perfect. It is common for some functions to not work properly, and a bad gaming experience may occur. If you don't want to encounter this situation, you can bookmark it and wait for a more stable game version. The problems found and development plans will be continuously updated in subsequent announcements.
Feedback
If you have any questions or feedback, please contact: feedback@aimstein.club
